name: meme-cut-v3
status: v3 (2026-10-19): text in the tiktok-caption style (TikTok Sans Medium 64, soft shadow, centred), approved by the author after the text-style research ("ну вот щас мне нравится"); v2 from the author's corrections of 2026-10-19 on "Потсдам — effortless": the cut ends on the last Meme insert (no finale), coloured key words, text inside the safe zone; v1 was the first published Meme cut ("Свидание — мой мозг", 2026-10-15) and Kostya's critique of it
audience: a man (18–60+) scrolling Reels who stops for a pretty, self-ironic woman; the joke is relatable and gets sent to friends
_doc: Style profile of the Meme cut Format (ADR 0009): one full profile, nothing inherited from the root style.json. Readers: cf.memecut (pacing, text, inserts, render, audio, ending, colors.key_words), overlays/render.mjs through the overlay specs cf.memecut writes (canvas, safe_zone, typography, colors incl. key_words, overlay_positions, animation) and cf.render_check (canvas, audio.music false = a silent track passes). Pixel numbers except canvas.width/height are 1080-wide reference px (x2 at 2160x3840), as in the Walk Reel profile. Durations are seconds and are checked in frames at canvas.fps (round(s x fps)).

portrait.note: the only canvas: a Meme cut is vertical

safe_zone.source: Meta Ads Guide 14% top / 35% bottom; sides 130 px, not Meta's 6% (65 px): Instagram on a tall phone (iPhone 19.5:9; her screenshot is 920x2000) shows a 9:16 Reel full-screen by height and crops (1 - (920/2000)/(9/16))/2 = 9.1% off each side, about 98 px at 1080; 98 px crop + 32 px margin = 130. Found on her post "Офис — нишевые слова для парня" (2026-10-19): the left edge of the list was cut off ('niche' lost its n, the numbers 1)-9) were cut) (same as the Walk Reel profile)

typography.preset_note: TikTok Sans Medium 500, 64 px (reference), line height 1.2, white, shadow 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.75), no outline, no box, centred, at most 820 px wide (overlays/src/presets.ts). The native TikTok caption look; replaces bold-outline-wide (Nunito Black with outline and heavy shadow, which looked like a meme generator; author 2026-10-19). Research: ~/Movies/content-factory/research/text-style-2026-10.md

stroke.note: a 2-px black outline in place of the shadow, for a line over a bright or white background; a Script picks it per text with "style": "stroke"

text.tone: deadpan: no exclamation marks; an emoji only when it fits the video or the text
text.emoji_note: emoji on screen in the whole cut (setup and punch together)

size.note: font size in reference px (1080 wide), 60–72 (tiktok-caption): outside it is a problem. A line too wide for 820 px is broken with \n, not set smaller

punch_anchor.note: centred in the blurred band above the meme: the text box's bottom edge sits above_meme_px (24–40) over the top edge of the highest blur-fill insert (cf.memecut computes y per cut); y is the fallback when every insert fills the frame

text.anchor_note: Centred text, at most 820 px wide, so it stays 130 px from both sides (Instagram crops ~98 px a side on a tall phone). The setup sits at 24–35 % of the height over her footage, off her face and body: a Script picks setup.anchor off the frames whenever the default would touch her (the text box stays at least body_clear_px from her body; cf.memecut checks it against the person detector). The punch sits in the blurred band 24–40 px above the meme's top edge.

key_word.note: each text (setup, punch) marks exactly one key word or phrase in the whole text: {words} or {words|<colour>}, a colour name from colors.key_words; a bare mark takes default_color (setup pink, punch yellow). None is a warning, more than one a problem

setup_band.note: the setup text's top edge sits at 24–35 % of the height (y 461–672 reference), off her face; outside it is a warning

style.note: setup.style / punch.style: "stroke" takes typography.variants.stroke (a 2-px outline) for a line over a bright background; omitted = the soft shadow

colors.key_words_note: the key word's fill; the shadow (or the stroke variant's outline) stays the base text's

overlay_positions._units: reference px (canvas.reference_width); render.mjs needs every role, the Meme cut uses only 'line'

animation.note: text is on from frame 0 of its part and cuts with it; no fades

last_insert_s.note: the last Meme insert ends the cut: the strongest beat, held longest

target_length_s.note: the approved cut: setup 2.5 + 3 x 1.0 + 1.5 = 7.0 s

finale_s.note: deprecated: only for old Scripts with a finale (a warning); there the last insert is an ordinary one

inserts.fit_note: auto: 'fill' when the trimmed source's short side is at least the canvas short side (a 4K stock shot), else 'blur-fill'. fill = cover the canvas with a centred crop. blur-fill = the picture whole at full width (full height for one taller than 9:16), centred, over a blurred, darkened, zoomed copy of itself. Never stretched: every scale keeps the aspect to within a pixel. trim (left/right/top/bottom, source px) cuts logos and watermarks off before either fit, so they are in neither the picture nor the blur.

blur_fill.note: the background is blurred at work_scale of the canvas (sigma in px of a 540-wide work frame, scaled with it) and upscaled

inserts.fill_upscale_note: a fill that upscales more than this is a warning: the picture will look soft; use a 4K shot or blur-fill
inserts.finale_fit_note: deprecated, for old Scripts with a finale

transitions.note: hard cuts only; the cut from the setup to the punch is the joke

color.rule: original colour, as on the Mac (author, 2026-10-12): her setup clip comes from the Apple-tone-mapped mezzanine (<footage>/mezz/, cf.mezz) for HDR clips, the raw file for SDR; no grade, no Look. Memes as they are.

audio.note: no music and no meme sound: the author adds the sound in Instagram. The file carries a silent stereo AAC track (Instagram and render_check expect an audio stream); render_check passes it as silent instead of measuring -14 LUFS.

speech.note: the setup clip's sound is dropped anyway

ending.note: the cut ends on its last Meme insert: no loop, no finale, no return to her footage

caption.note: one short deadpan line in English (one emoji at most) that adds to the text on screen, up to 5 hashtags, the geotag; no CTA, no alt text

reframe.note: the setup clip fills the canvas with a centred crop (a portrait clip just scales); trim picks another window

render.engine: ffmpeg (cf.memecut), not Resolve: Resolve FX on a clip are out of the API (docs/resolve-rules.md, Known gaps)
